package domain

import (
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func TestNormalizeStudentLearningPathAllowsOneReadyAndMasteredSkips(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 8, 31, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	path, err := NormalizeStudentLearningPath(StudentLearningPath{
		ID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", StudentID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		CourseID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", GoalCode: "backend", CurriculumRevision: "sha256:abc",
		PolicyVersion: LearningPathPolicyVersion, PlannerPolicyVersion: "teacher-curriculum-planner-v1",
		ReasonCode: "initial_gap_analysis", ReasonSummary: "Skip mastered prerequisites.",
		Version: 1, CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now,
		Items: []LearningPathItem{
			{ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", Position: 0, Status: LearningPathItemSkippedMastered, ReasonCode: "already_mastered"},
			{ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555", Position: 1, Status: LearningPathItemReady, ReasonCode: "first_gap"},
		},
	})
	if err != nil || len(path.Items) != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("normalize path: %#v %v", path, err)
	}
	if path.Status != LearningPathStatusActive {
		t.Fatalf("legacy path must default to ACTIVE, got %s", path.Status)
	}
}

func TestNormalizeStudentLearningPathRejectsPrimaryPausedPath(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	_, err := NormalizeStudentLearningPath(StudentLearningPath{
		ID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", StudentID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		CourseID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", GoalCode: "backend", CurriculumRevision: "sha256:abc",
		PolicyVersion: LearningPathPolicyVersion, PlannerPolicyVersion: "teacher-curriculum-planner-v1",
		ReasonCode: "initial_gap_analysis", ReasonSummary: "Start here.", Status: LearningPathStatusPaused,
		IsPrimary: true, Version: 1, CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now,
		Items: []LearningPathItem{{
			ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
			Position: 0, Status: LearningPathItemReady, ReasonCode: "first_gap",
		}},
	})
	if err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected a primary paused path to be rejected")
	}
}

func TestNormalizeStudentLearningContextDefinesJourneyAggregateVersion(t *testing.T) {
	empty, err := NormalizeStudentLearningContext(StudentLearningContext{
		StudentID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
	})
	if err != nil || empty.Version != 0 || empty.Schema != LearningContextSchemaVersion {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected virtual context: %#v err=%v", empty, err)
	}
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	stored, err := NormalizeStudentLearningContext(StudentLearningContext{
		StudentID:              "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		SelectedLearningPathID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
		Version:                3, UpdatedAt: &now,
	})
	if err != nil || stored.Version != 3 || stored.SelectedLearningPathID == "" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected stored context: %#v err=%v", stored, err)
	}
}

func TestNormalizeDiagnosticKeepsUnknownExplicit(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	result, err := NormalizeStudentDiagnosticSnapshot(StudentDiagnosticSnapshot{
		ID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", StudentID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		AssessmentID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", CurriculumRevision: "sha256:abc",
		PolicyVersion: DiagnosticPolicyVersion, CompletedAt: now,
		Items: []DiagnosticSnapshotItem{{Target: LearningTargetRef{Type: LearningTargetConcept, Key: "go.interfaces"}, State: TargetMasteryUnknown}},
	})
	if err != nil || result.Items[0].State != TargetMasteryUnknown {
		t.Fatalf("normalize diagnostic: %#v %v", result, err)
	}
}
